name: Mica comparable price outlier benchmark v1
reviewInstructions: Confirm that each flagged index is an observation a reasonable reviewer would send to manual review. Flags do not delete or exclude data.

cases.reason: A tight five-sale cohort should remain included.
A ten-times price should be reviewed, not silently included or deleted.
A likely partial, damaged, or mapping mismatch should be reviewed.
Two observations cannot support an automatic exclusion recommendation.
A broadly distributed cohort has no isolated robust outlier.
Small absolute prices should not be flagged merely for rounding variation.
The relative rule should still detect an isolated multiplier at low prices.
A zero-MAD cohort with no deviation contains no outlier.
